run_MDRunner_calculate: run a molecular dynamics simulation on a single structure using an ASE calculator and thermostat
create_MDRunner: create an MDRunner instance with a calculator, thermostat, atoms, timestep, and step count for MD simulation
save_MDRunner_simulation_state: save the MD simulation state including atoms positions, velocities, and thermostat state to a checkpoint directory
load_MDRunner_simulation_state: load MD simulation state from a checkpoint directory to resume from a previous step
write_MDRunner_results: write MD simulation results metadata as JSON including trajectory file, log file, and elapsed time
